user.title: Kohler Konnect
user.description: Sign in with your Kohler Konnect account. Every Anthem valve, Anthem Plus controller and Sensate faucet on it is added. Sign-in happens entirely within Home Assistant — there is no browser step and nothing to copy back.

valve.title: Select your valve
valve.description:
Found: {summary}

Your valve's outlet layout could not be read automatically, so choose your Anthem digital valve model. This decides how many outlets exist and which zone each belongs to. It is required even with only an Anthem Plus controller, because the controller reports outlets per zone using the same layout.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {username} has expired. Enter the password again to reconnect. If the email address of your Kohler account has changed since, enter the new one.

error.invalid_auth: Kohler rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kohler. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.signin_blocked: Kohler needs an extra step to sign in (for example two-factor authentication), which this integration cannot complete.
error.no_devices: That account has no device this integration supports: Anthem valves, Anthem Plus controllers and Sensate faucets. Note that an Anthem Plus touchscreen (K-28214-ASC) only adds the controller — adding the valve itself requires a first-generation Anthem touchscreen (K-28214).

abort.already_configured: This Kohler account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Kohler account from the one this entry belongs to.

init.title: Kohler Konnect options
init.description:
**Zone grouping** decides how outlets, zone controls (Temperature, Flow) and zone sensors (Shower Active, Hex) are named and grouped. It only affects valves with two zones (K-28211 and K-28212); on a single-zone valve all three choices look the same.

**Water safety limit** applies to faucets.

data.sidebar_panel: Show the Kohler Konnect panel in the sidebar

data_description.max_run_minutes: Turn the water off this many minutes after it's turned on from Home Assistant, unless it's turned off in the meantime. 0 turns the limit off.
data_description.sidebar_panel: One panel for every user, with your devices' controls, water use and details. Turning it off removes it from the sidebar straight away.

options.subdevices: Sub-device per zone — separate Zone 1 / Zone 2 devices, no zone numbers on outlets or controls
options.outlet_labels: Outlet names on controls — single device, e.g. Temperature (Showerhead, Body Sprays)
options.numbered: Zone numbers (default) — single device, appends 1 / 2 to outlets and controls

auth_failed.message: Kohler rejected the saved credentials. Sign in again from the integration page.

update_failed.message: Error talking to the Kohler cloud: {error}

command_failed.message: The Kohler cloud did not accept the command: {error}

faucet_offline.message: {name} is offline: Kohler's cloud can't reach the faucet. Check its power and Wi-Fi.

handle_closed.message: {name}'s handle is closed. Open the handle to dispense water remotely.

firmware_updating.message: {name} is installing a firmware update. Try again when it has finished.

not_dispensed.message: Kohler couldn't dispense water from {name}. Turn the faucet on by hand.

command_forbidden.message: Kohler refused the command for {name} with this sign-in. Check for an update to this integration.

rate_limited.message: Kohler is limiting requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

preset_out_of_range.message: The preset "{title}" is outside the 10 mL to 11.36 L (3 gallon) dispense range.

preset_not_found.message: {name} has no preset called "{preset}". Its presets: {presets}.

no_faucet.message: No Sensate faucet is set up and running.

faucet_not_selected.message: The selected device is not a Sensate faucet. Choose a faucet.

faucet_required.message: More than one faucet is set up. Choose which faucet should dispense.

settings_while_running.message: {name} is running, and its settings can't change until it stops, as in the Konnect app.

settings_unreadable.message: {name}'s current settings couldn't be read, so nothing was changed: they are all replaced at once. Try again.

toilet_not_seated.message: {name} only starts a spray or the dryer for someone who is seated, as in the Konnect app.

toilet_seated.message: {name} can't do that while someone is seated, as in the Konnect app.

evocycle_fault.message: {name} reports fault {code}. Check it in the Konnect app before starting anything.

evocycle_cleaning.message: {name} is running an ozone clean. The shower can start once the clean has finished.

evocycle_running.message: {name} is running. An ozone clean starts only when the shower is off and nobody is in it.

ice_bath_session_exists.message: {name} already has a session on {day}. The journal keeps one a day, so this one wasn't recorded.

ice_bath_in_future.message: A session can't finish in the future.

ice_bath_temperature.message: The temperature must be between {low} and {high} {unit}, what the journal can hold.

ice_bath_before_journal.message: {name}'s journal began on {day}, so no session can be logged before then.

toilet_cleaning.message: {name} is running its UV clean. Wait until it has finished, as in the Konnect app.

fan_schedule_same_times.message: A schedule can't start and end at the same time: it must run for less than 24 hours, as in the Konnect app.

fan_schedule_no_days.message: Choose the days for a schedule that runs on chosen days.

panel_settings_while_running.message: {name} is running water: its touch panels' settings can't be saved until it stops, as in the Konnect app.

panel_settings_unreadable.message: {name}'s touch panel settings don't read as the Konnect app expects ({reason}), so nothing was changed: every panel's settings are written at once.

dispense.name: Dispense water
dispense.description: Dispenses a measured amount of water, or a Konnect preset, from a Sensate faucet.

device_id.name: Faucet
device_id.description: The faucet to dispense from. Optional when only one faucet is set up.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much water to dispense, in the chosen unit (between 10 mL and 11.36 L, or 3 gallons).

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the amount. Defaults to mL, or fl oz when your Konnect account uses US units.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset saved in the Konnect app, by its name in the Preset dropdown. Use instead of amount.

log_ice_bath_session.name: Log an ice bath session
log_ice_bath_session.description: Records a session in an Ice Bath journal, as the Konnect app's New Record does: when, how long and how cold. A day that already has a session is refused rather than overwritten.

device_id.name: Journal
device_id.description: The Ice Bath journal to record it in.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long it lasted. Ten minutes or more is recorded as the app's 10+.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: How cold, in Home Assistant's temperature unit: 36–75 °F or 2–24 °C, what the journal can hold.

completed.name: Finished
completed.description: When it ended. Defaults to now.

set_fan_schedule.name: Set a fan schedule
set_fan_schedule.description: Sets a Smart Fan's schedule as the Konnect app's Fan Schedule editor does: when it starts and ends, how it repeats and at what speed. Saving switches the schedule on. It can't change while the fan runs.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Every day, once, or on the days chosen below. Every day if left out.

days.name: Days
days.description: The days it runs on, when it repeats on chosen days.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: The fan's speed while the schedule runs. The one it has if left out.

set_ice_bath_routine.name: Set an ice bath routine
set_ice_bath_routine.description: Changes an Ice Bath journal's routine as the Konnect app's Routine screen does: its weekdays or how many sessions a week, and its reminders. Give only what should change.

device_id.name: Journal
device_id.description: The Ice Bath journal whose routine to change.

days.name: Days
days.description: The weekdays a session is planned for. Give this or sessions a week, not both.

sessions_per_week.name: Sessions a week
sessions_per_week.description: How many sessions a week, on any days.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Whether the app reminds you of the routine.

follow_ups.name: Follow-up questions
follow_ups.description: Whether the app asks how you felt after a session. Your answers stay in the app.

outlet_write_unverified.title: A shower setting may not have been applied
outlet_write_unverified.description:
Home Assistant asked your valve to change **{setting}**, and the valve accepted the request — but reading the value back afterwards did not show the change.

{detail}

**What this means.** Kohler's API answers "accepted for delivery", never "applied", so this check exists to catch the difference. The setting may still be the old value.

**What to do.** Open the entity and set it again. If it fails a second time, check the valve is online in the Kohler Konnect app — a valve that has dropped off the cloud accepts commands that never reach it.

This message clears when a change verifies.

faucet_not_found.title: {name} is no longer on your Kohler account
faucet_not_found.description:
Kohler no longer lists this faucet on your account, so Home Assistant can't read or control it. If you removed or replaced it in the Konnect app, reload the Kohler Konnect integration to pick up the change.

Last error: {error}

faucet_api_changed.title: Kohler keeps rejecting requests for {name}
faucet_api_changed.description:
Kohler's cloud has rejected several requests in a row, which usually means Kohler changed its API. Check for an update to this integration. If there's none, open an issue and attach the integration's diagnostics.

Last error: {error}

faucet_auto_off_failed.title: {name}'s water may still be running
faucet_auto_off_failed.description:
Water turned on from Home Assistant at {name} reached its safety limit, but Home Assistant hasn't been able to turn it off: Kohler's cloud didn't take the command, or the faucet hasn't reported its water off since.

Home Assistant keeps trying — after 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes, then every 15 minutes — until the water is known to be off, across restarts too. If it's still running, turn it off at the faucet.

This message clears once the water is known to be off.

Last error: {error}

replaced_integration.title: Remove the old Kohler integrations
replaced_integration.description:
Kohler Konnect replaces the Kohler Anthem and Kohler Sensate integrations, and these entries of theirs are still set up: {entries}.

They control the same devices as Kohler Konnect, so their entities are duplicates, and each keeps its own connection to Kohler. Move any automations over to the Kohler Konnect entities, then delete the old entries from **Settings → Devices & services** and remove the old integrations in HACS.

This message clears once they are deleted.
